proposals.evidence: Turner *pōḍ burn explicitly lists Khowar pāleik, Assamese poriba, Bengali poṛā/puṛā and Oriya poṛibā/puṛ-. These simple regional verbs, ordinary infinitives/pasts and the eastern -āna causative continuum belong to that documented family. The entry does not claim an Indo-European derivation and its comparison with Greek fire is explicitly rejected.
